messages:
Jo: Heads up we've been asked to put together a short 'cloud partner quickstart' focused on Terraform modules + ref arch for marketplace listings. Need something partner-friendly, copy/pasteable.

Arjun: Proposal: make a tiny reference arch per cloud (1 VPC, 2 subnets, LB, autoscaling group / instance pool for inference) and provide a single-entrypoint module + examples for common patterns (kms, s3 endpoints, vpc endpoints). Keep defaults safe.

Tess: +1. Also include a small diagram (SVG) and a one-page checklist that marketplace teams can attach to the listing. Checklist items: minimum IAM, encryption at rest, network ACLs, runbook contact, and SLA expectations.

Jo: Good. Who can own AWS module first? Partner launch is early May.

Arjun: I'm in for AWS. Plan: AWS module with 3 example stacks: demo (single node), HA (autoscaling + LB), and private (VPC-only, no public LB). Each example is a small tfvars file. Deliver by 04/20.

Tess: I'll draft the one-page checklist and the README template for marketplace docs. Make the README include: short architecture blurb, quick deploy (terraform init/apply), cleanup, security notes, and troubleshooting.

Jo: CI: we should add a lightweight smoke pipeline that runs the demo deploy in sandbox, hits /health and performs a simple inference call. CI-Bot can post results.

CI-Bot: Note: sandbox account `sandbox-marketplace` is available. Add `ci/deploy.sh` and `ci/test.sh` to the repo.

Arjun: For the TF registry question  publish later. For now we'll reference the GH module. We'll add a Makefile: `make deploy-demo` and `make destroy-demo` to keep manual steps simple.

Tess: Legal: any special data processing language needed for marketplace listing? LegalBot can we get a short blurb?

LegalBot: Draft blurb: "This integration processes inference requests and stores transient logs in S3 for diagnostics. Customers should enable KMS and rotate keys per their policy. No PII is stored by default; partners must disclose any telemetry." Use Security contact `security@redwood.ai` for reviews.

Jo: Nice. Action items: @Arjun -> AWS module + examples + Makefile (PR draft by 04/20). @Tess -> README template + checklist (04/15). @Jo -> GH issue + labels + add CI skeleton (today). @LegalBot -> finalize blurb and DM the marketplace PM.

Arjun: Quick tech note: include variables for instance_type, asg_min/asg_max, ami_id, and option to enable `use_spot`. Document cost implications.

Tess: Add a short 'limitations' section: not production hardened, intended for onboarding and demo, recommend Dedicated/Private for production.

Jo: Great. I'll schedule a 25min sync next Wed to review PRs. Thanks team :rocket:

CI-Bot: Created issue redwood-inference/marketplace-iac#58 - "cloud-partner-quickstart-modules" https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-iac/issues/58
